one attractive and one repulsive relation per agent
deterministic relation updates over 960 integration steps
subtitle: synchronous point-agent updates with nonlocal attraction and repulsion
summary: Simulation of 100 000 point agents. At each step, every agent receives centroid contraction, attraction toward one indexed partner, and repulsion from another indexed partner. Partner assignment is independent of spatial proximity and changes on a deterministic schedule over 960 steps. The point distribution records the combined effects of position integration and the time-varying relation graph; no biological or social equivalence is claimed.
title: NONLOCAL AFFINITY GRAPH DYNAMICS
